Columns are three animation beats: prepare, peak, settle. Hand-painted luminous fantasy painterly strokes, crisp visible core and fine wispy ends, coral #F88279 and warm gold #FFD28B with ivory accents. Row1 VALOR: small gathering warm ring; three rising warm elliptical rings with a few tiny sparks arcing sideways to allies; small fading warm sparks. Row2 FINALE: gathered thin song ribbons; one broad flowing coral-gold ribbon wave moving right with one leading crescent, no multiple hit explosions; one compact single starless abstract impact fan. Row3 DREAD: small violet-coral knotted ribbon; jagged discordant violet-coral wave moving right to ONE target; a small broken trembling zigzag mark in dark violet and coral, no skulls. Row5 SOLO: gentle low warm pool; narrow translucent spotlight-like column with hollow airy center, warm ellipse base; short soft fading pool. ALL forms must be original abstract note-like ribbons and shapes, NO real musical notation, no clefs, no staff lines, no letters or symbols copied from scores. Airy layered paint, not thick opaque discs. All isolated on alpha. This is variant R1, softer flowing arcs.
